question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, SUM(res.points) as total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND res.points > 0
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
),
min_points_per_season AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
),
min_constructors AS (
    SELECT cp.year, cp.constructor_id, cp.total_points, mps.min_points
    FROM constructor_points cp
    JOIN min_points_per_season mps ON cp.year = mps.year AND cp.total_points = mps.min_points
),
constructor_counts AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, COUNT(*) as seasons_with_fewest_points
    FROM min_constructors
    GROUP BY constructor_id
),
top5 AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, seasons_with_fewest_points
    FROM constructor_counts
    ORDER BY seasons_with_fewest_points DESC, constructor_id
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT t.seasons_with_fewest_points, c.name as constructor_name, t.constructor_id
FROM top5 t
JOIN constructors c ON t.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY t.seasons_with_fewest_points DESC, t.constructor_id
